title: His
html_source:
Stephen is referred to in third person here, establishing the narrator as being somewhat independent of the hero. (Stephen would have been too young to refer to this moment in first person.)

This is the manner by which Joyce depicts Dedalus’s growth in the Künstlerroman—"a narrative about an artist’s growth to maturity."
